I now prefer it to my $13,000 wedding set and only wear the set on weekends or nights out. My second child is due in December and I love that I won't have to go without my wedding jewelry for fear of cutting her with my stone. I definitely recommend this product!

Glides on your finger like butter and is the perfect width if your fingers are not as long as nail polish models are. It has that steel grey darker platinum look that is so flattering to all skin tones. I really cannot imagine why anyone would spend money for a gold ring when you can get something this fabulous looking and hard wearing as this ring. It's a real winner and keeper for me ! One of the best jewelry items I have ever purchased !

Best ring, best price if this is the style, color and size you are looking for.
